raw_block.rationale: Create the requested two-stage legal graph for disclosure questions. The preliminary helper determines whether the query's recipient category reaches Paragraph 4(a)'s representative exception, including the existential overlap between “professional advisors” and the expressly permitted legal or financial advisors. The terminal then applies Paragraph 3(c)'s general prohibition subject to that exception. This directly targets the failed nda-7 view while also handling nda-5.
